svg.title: The Kingdom You Built — GitHub Activity Replay
svg.desc: A Mario replay of Gurtejhundal's last twelve GitHub contribution weeks, 2026-08-16 to 2026-11-06. 166 contributions become exactly 166 coins. 32 active days become brick rows. Mario jumps across the actual weekly terrain and collects each week's contribution bundle. 2026-08-16 to 2026-08-22: 9 contributions, 5 active days. 2026-08-23 to 2026-08-29: 14 contributions, 6 active days. 2026-08-30 to 2026-09-05: 9 contributions, 4 active days. 2026-09-06 to 2026-09-12: 10 contributions, 5 active days. 2026-09-13 to 2026-09-19: 50 contributions, 3 active days. 2026-09-20 to 2026-09-26: 0 contributions, 0 active days. 2026-09-27 to 2026-10-03: 45 contributions, 3 active days. 2026-10-04 to 2026-10-10: 0 contributions, 0 active days. 2026-10-11 to 2026-10-17: 0 contributions, 0 active days. 2026-10-18 to 2026-10-24: 0 contributions, 0 active days. 2026-10-25 to 2026-10-31: 0 contributions, 0 active days. 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-06: 29 contributions, 6 active days.
svg.text: My GitHub activity becomes the level. Mario plays it back.
1 COIN = 1 CONTRIBUTION / 1 RAISED ROW = 1 ACTIVE DAY
